ptbxl.rule: highest-confidence diagnostic superclass; NORM=normal and MI/STTC/CD/HYP=abnormal

mitbih.rule: 10-second 250 Hz windows; majority valid beat label; ties and excluded-only windows dropped

comparability_limit: PTB-XL diagnostic superclasses and MIT-BIH beat-rhythm annotations are different label sources; external evaluation is a generalization check, not a label-equivalence claim.
